name: Realtime game tracking remains live
description: Verifies the normal realtime tracking flow still works while session recovery is enabled.
steps: Start a configured game on the paired Windows PC
Observe it in the GameTracker Live Monitor
expected: The game appears without refresh, disappears from Live Monitor after ending, and the completed session remains in Session History.

name: Recovered session is visible after an Agent restart
description: Verifies an active session persisted by the Windows Agent can become a durable recovered session after the Agent restarts while the game is no longer running.
steps: Start a configured game on the paired Windows PC
Restart the Windows Agent while the session is active
Open Session History after the Agent reconnects
expected: The interrupted session remains recorded and is visibly labeled as Recovered rather than being silently lost.

name: Recovered session keeps a defensible end time
description: Verifies recovered sessions show their recorded duration and explain that the end time is based on the last known Agent heartbeat.
steps: Open Session History on a phone-sized viewport
expected: The recovered session shows a duration, an end time, and a clear note that the interruption uses the last known Agent heartbeat as the estimated end.

name: Normal sessions are not mislabeled as recovered
description: Verifies normally closed sessions keep their normal presentation and are not marked as recovered.
steps: Open Session History containing a normally completed session
expected: The normal session has no Recovered badge and is identified as a normally closed game session.
